patent.title: Trackbed liner and related methods
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-17. Sole EP(UK) in Geofabrics v Fiberweb HP-2018-000003. Prefer over any sibling geosynthetic patents not adjudicated in that case.

knowledge_origin.description: Geofabrics Ltd assignee; inventorship Warwick/Leech; corporate RD assumed.

technology.problem: Restrict pumping erosion of clay particles from subgrade into railway ballast without a thick sand blanket.
technology.mechanism: Trackbed liner with upper/lower support layers and a filtration layer that is normally liquid-water impermeable but, under vehicle load, permits upward liquid water while restricting solids passage.

value_carriers.name: Geofabrics Tracktex trackbed liner (plaintiff commercial embodiment)
value_carriers.description: Court treats Tracktex as the patented product competing with infringing Hydrotex 2.

value_metrics.metric_name: court damages inquiry quantum for infringement of EP(UK)2430238
value_metrics.note: Single-patent damages. Dispute-specific (lost profits / price competition / depression + interest); not FMV / intrinsic price.

gaps.description: Damages are litigation-context (counterfactual lost profits, price depression); not a market license schedule or FMV.
No field-normalized quality score beyond infringement finding.

notes: Holdout INT-17. T0=2026-10-13. Single-patent court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent metric—those are present. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
